title: [review] C root applies delegated-prefix-only DAOs that Rust rejects (identical-decisions invariant break)
description: P2, wave-7 review. rpl_dao_process.c:756-886 process_dao has no found_origin equivalent: a verified-origin DAO advertising ONLY delegated prefixes (no self /128 target) is APPLIED by the C root, while Rust rejects it (routing.rs:669 + sender_is_authorized routing.rs:727-760 requires >=1 canonical target == origin). Wave-7 created this class (the old all-targets==origin gate made it unreachable in C). Not a bypass (origin IS delegated) but breaks identical-decisions for mixed C/Rust meshes. Fix: add the found_origin check (>=1 canonical target == origin) to process_dao after the gate, or document the C extension as intentional in spec/05-routing.md 8.7 - coordinate the decision across impls.
close_reason: Re-close (2nd; store reversion per biod). Fix intact: f9d16eac3b.
